formal_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (F : Finset ℕ), PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 n C → (∀ j ∈ F, j < C.gates.length ∧ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧ PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.OrReaches n C C.output j) → F.card ≤ Set.ncard {i : ℕ | i < C.gates.length ∧ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C i).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∧ PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.OrReaches n C C.output i} + 1
plain_statement: C has AND and OR gates, each reading exactly two earlier wires. If F is a set of m AND gates of C, each reaching the output wire through OR gates only (the gate may itself be the output), then the OR gates of C that reach the output wire through OR gates only number at least m - 1.
title: AND/OR circuits, fan-in exactly two: m AND gates with OR-only paths to the output force at least m - 1 OR gates with OR-only paths to the output
